usage: dispatch_driver.py [-h]
                          {round,review,panel,skeptics,fix-tasks,complete,finish,answer,status,reassign-model,_child}
                          ...

Deterministic dispatch driver for one build wave. Composes the canonical
helpers in the build contract's order: recover, ready, brief lint, task
isolation, child dispatch, Verify, landing, verify ledger, retire. Every
action re-derives its state from Git, the task files, and the dispatch records
under the Git common directory, so a call may be repeated after a crash or a
tool timeout. The driver never edits task frontmatter, commits, or creates a
checkout itself: isolation.py and build_state.py own those. Children are
spawned through an owner-supplied command that reads the brief on stdin; the
owner therefore owns the child's permission posture.

positional arguments:
  {round,review,panel,skeptics,fix-tasks,complete,finish,answer,status,reassign-model,_child}
    round               settle, land, and dispatch the current wave
    review              run one wave review cycle at full or deep depth
    panel               run the optional review panel for a collected wave
                        review
    skeptics            run one finding skeptic per needs-skeptic locator
    fix-tasks           write one fix task per findings batch of a blocked
                        cycle
    complete            prove every wave landed and passed review, record
                        landing evidence, enter ship
    finish              verify, land, record, and retire one in-progress task
                        whose coder has returned
    answer              record an orchestrator answer for a question
    status              list dispatch records
    reassign-model      record an explicit model reassignment
    _child              ==SUPPRESS==

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: isolation.py [-h]
                    {isolate-task,activate-task,deactivate-task,isolate-verify,land,attest,adopt-rebase,recover,collect-artifact,checkpoint,retire}
                    ...

Named checkouts for task isolation, verify sidecars, and task landing. The
orchestrator calls this helper instead of inventing git worktree, commit, or
cherry-pick commands. Every checkout this module creates is a named branch; it
never detaches HEAD.

positional arguments:
  {isolate-task,activate-task,deactivate-task,isolate-verify,land,attest,adopt-rebase,recover,collect-artifact,checkpoint,retire}
    isolate-task        create or reuse a named task checkout
    activate-task       record one helper-owned task dispatch
    deactivate-task     revoke one helper-owned task dispatch
    isolate-verify      create a named verify sidecar
    land                commit a task onto the bound branch
    attest              record an owner ruling that a done task's work is
                        already on the branch
    adopt-rebase        record an owner ruling adopting every done task's
                        rebased landing
    recover             prove landed task commits from git; read-only
    collect-artifact    atomically collect one verified sidecar artifact
    checkpoint          commit allowlisted pipeline bookkeeping
    retire              remove a named sidecar checkout

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
